name: Shard Legends: Clan Wars
storyline:
The Fragile Harmony
For a long time, the 12 Great Cities of the Empire existed in perfect balance. The ruling Lords forged an unspoken pact: trade caravans crossed the continents freely, the forges never slept, and the economy thrived. It was a golden age of civilization where every city knew its purpose. But this peace had a price. The borders of the Empire were constantly besieged by hordes of beasts from the Wild Lands. To preserve internal harmony, the finest warriors marched to the borders daily, holding back the primordial chaos.
The Expedition into the Abyss
One day, defense was no longer enough. The most powerful Clans of the Empire united to push the monster hordes back into the depths of the Wild Lands once and for all. Clearing the wastelands mile by mile, they broke through the veil of fog and discovered something that changed the course of history forever. The Wild Lands were not just barren wastes—they concealed virgin territories coursing with veins of the rarest, most incredibly valuable resources the Empire had only heard of in legends.
Greed and War
News of the new wealth spread through the Cities like wildfire. The fragile diplomatic balance collapsed overnight. Yesterday’s brothers-in-arms, who stood shoulder to shoulder defending the borders, drove blades into each other's backs for control over the new territories. Trade routes turned into frontlines, and the economy, once built for creation, began to fuel an endless war.
The Empire will never be the same. The era of peace is dead. The time of the Clan Wars has begun, where survival belongs not to the righteous, but to those who control the resources. Whose side will you choose?
summary: A hardcore sandbox MMORPG with an economy entirely controlled by players. No NPC merchants: every sword is forged by a real person, and the 18 Great Cities are ruled by real players. Build monopolies, raid caravans, and make your mark on the Empire’s history.
